pkgmetadata.longdescription: Umbriel is a Wayland compositor built on wlroots, with scrolling, dwindle, master, and stacking layouts, per-output workspaces, window rules, blur, shadows, and fluid animations.

use.flag: Use jemalloc for the compositor heap on glibc systems.
Enable Little CMS support for client ICC profiles.
Install Xwayland for X11 application support.
